lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-orthogonal arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters on the mid-lateral flank, organized into approximately five horizontal rows and multiple vertical columns posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to create a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the central lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance on the dorsal side to shadow-induced low luminance on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density clustering of small, high-luminance blobs on the surface of the pectoral fin, showing a gradient of decreasing blob diameter toward the distal and posterior edges.
